About this product

  • Release date: 5 December 2025.

The PlayStation 5 Pro Console offers a step up in visual fidelity for players who want to experience games at their peak on home hardware. This 2TB Digital Edition includes PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution for AI-enhanced resolution on your 4K TV, plus advanced ray tracing for reflections and shadows throughout your gaming. The console supports both 60Hz and 120Hz displays, and features an SSD that loads installed PS5 games quickly. You can also enable an Enhanced Image Quality setting for select PS4 games, giving your existing library improved resolution where supported.

This is a home console designed for ages 7 and over, with Wi-Fi 7 compatibility that works alongside compatible routers for online gaming. What's included in the box - PS5 Pro console, one DualSense wireless controller, HDMI cable, AC power cord, USB cable, two horizontal stand feet, and ASTRO's PLAYROOM pre-installed. The vertical stand sells separately if you prefer that orientation. With 2TB storage built in, there's space for your digital game collection, and you can play single-player adventures, online multiplayer, or local co-op depending on the games you own.

  • 2000 GB hard drive to play games, watch movies and music.

Included:

  • 1 wireless controller - DualSense.
  • AC power cord.
